compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.30 preserves every declared page icon during site capture and fetches page assets using the same browser agent that loaded the page. reCast does not currently expose an equivalent remote site-capture command, so no unsupported CLI surface was added.

HyperFrames v0.8.30 hardens Studio bundle/signature/runtime reads and checked descriptor handling, and bounds several parser and style/font scans. reCast's independent browser Studio and CLI do not implement the corresponding bundle/signature or external-file scanning architecture, so these implementation-specific hardening changes do not alter an exposed compatibility interface.

HyperFrames v0.8.30 isolates temporary WAV staging and chunked encoding files. reCast already creates a per-render unique frame staging directory and removes it after rendering; its current single-pass encoder does not expose upstream chunked encoding behavior, so no additional compatibility API change is required.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
